notes.title: SONG + NAME
notes.text: SONG + NAME (upstream Felucca 1.0's song chain and naming): SEQ > SONG plays up to 16 rows of {project A..D, repeat x1..x16} with the sounds loaded now (each row: that project's steps, LEN / DIV / SWING / SRC and motion; a row lasts its longest track; LOOP ON / OFF; STOP brings the current pattern back). Projects get names (the PROJECT page's NAME knob opens the NAME screen: keys type phone-style, KNOB 1 / 2 cursor and character; SAVE saves as before); slots shown as A..D. Saved with the project (format FDR9; older projects load with no song and no name).
